content_of_post_to_comment: Heidegger’s critique of technology was that we became totally incapable of seeing the world and ourselves as anything but raw material for optimization and progress. That we’re clearly willing to blow everything up for a cooler AI model makes me think that cat was onto something.
comment: The unsettling part may be less that we optimize the world, and more that optimization erases the ability to recognize what cannot be measured. A society can become efficient at destroying its own conditions for meaning.
